title: Story Component Builder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Two-step builder in which learners sequence the six sales story components for a predictive maintenance sale, then write and review a complete story.

learningObjectives: Construct a sales story by arranging the six story components in the correct sequence and writing content for each component.
prerequisites: Sales Story Components section of Chapter 4

keyQuestions: Construct a sales story by arranging the six story components in the correct sequence and writing content for each component.
commonMisconceptions: Components can be in any order.
The call to action can be vague.
assessmentOpportunities: All six components in the correct sequence.
Each written component fulfills its role; the call to action names a concrete next step.
